plain: Plundering and robbing, often by an army or raiders.

webster.text: The act of plundering; a robbing; a pillaging.

example.quote: In a state so insignificant our commerce would be a prey to the wanton intermeddlings of all nations at war with each other; who, having nothing to fear from us, would with little scruple or remorse, supply their wants by depredations on our property as often as it fell in their way.
